topic: Fake remote job sends overpayment check for equipment, asks you to wire the difference (Nolan)

scenes.narration: A four thousand dollar check vanished overnight. Case file 0060. Let's open the evidence.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named detective cash, sharp blue eyes, gray fedora hat, beige trench coat, five o'clock shadow, holding magnifying glass and a manila file folder labeled with dollar signs, detective cash in a noir office holding a magnifying glass over a paper check stamped FORGED, comic banner reads ONE EIGHT HUNDRED GONE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nolan accepts a remote customer service job paying twenty four dollars hourly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man nolan at a kitchen table on a laptop with a job offer letter stamped CONGRATULATIONS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The hiring manager interviewed him only by text in under ten minutes.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nolan reading a fast text interview on his phone, a chat bubble reads YOU ARE HIRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Day one she sends a four thousand two hundred dollar check.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nolan holding a paper check at a kitchen table, comic banner reads FOR YOUR HOME OFFICE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Buy a laptop, monitor, and headset from our preferred vendor today.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a vendor name circled on a sticky note labeled PREFERRED VENDOR, an email open on a laptop with instructions, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nolan deposits the check and sees the balance the next morning.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a phone showing a bank balance going up by FOUR TWO HUNDRED, a smiling nolan holding the phone, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He wires one thousand eight hundred dollars to the vendor that day.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nolan at a bank wire desk handing a paper to a teller, comic banner reads ONE EIGHT HUNDRED OUT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Six business days later his bank discovers the original check is forged.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a bank app showing a CHECK BOUNCED notice in big red letters, a worried nolan staring at the screen, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His account drops to negative one thousand eight hundred dollars overnight.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked nolan at a kitchen table holding a bank app showing NEGATIVE ONE EIGHT HUNDRED in red, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The hiring manager's email bounces and the vendor website is gone.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a laptop showing two emails marked UNDELIVERABLE and a website screen reading PAGE NOT FOUND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: There was never a job, only a scammer using his bank.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a shadowy scammer silhouette laughing behind a fake job posting page on a computer, money raining offscreen, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Real employers ship equipment themselves. They never send checks to forward. Case closed.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named detective cash, sharp blue eyes, gray fedora hat, beige trench coat, five o'clock shadow, holding magnifying glass and a manila file folder labeled with dollar signs, detective cash holding a magnifying glass over a paper labeled REAL JOBS SHIP THE LAPTOP, comic banner reads CASE CLOSED, kids comic book illustration
